title: Shy's Secret Gift
reason: Keep the quiet-kindness mystery while simplifying dialogue, removing the all-night watch, making Shy's dinosaur identity clear, and ending with reciprocal friendship.

pages.1: Each morning, the Dino Pals found a small gift on the Big Flat Rock. No one knew who left it.
pages.2: One day, Grumpy found a smooth pebble. "Someone knows I like pebbles," he said.
pages.3: One day, Chompy found extra berries. "Someone knows me well!" he said, already eating.
pages.4: One day, Dozy found a leafy fan. "Perfect," he said, before falling asleep under it.
pages.5: "Who leaves the gifts?" asked Bossy. "We can watch quietly."
pages.6: Bouncy looked behind bushes. Zippy checked every path. Honky called out. They found no one.
pages.7: Cheeky kept watch after supper. He tried to stay awake, but soon he was asleep.
pages.8: The next morning, Sunny waited quietly behind a fern.
pages.9: She saw two small pink feet step from behind a rock. A tiny grass bracelet was placed on top.
pages.10: "Shy?" Sunny asked softly. Shy nodded and tucked behind the rock.
pages.11: "Your gifts are kind," said Sunny. "Would you like to sit with us?" Shy came out a little way.
pages.12: The next morning, eleven small gifts waited on the Big Flat Rock. The Pals had made one for Shy.
